name: Assemblée nationale
notes: Single chamber since the Senate was abolished in 2021. Chart by list from the Assemblée's own home page ("Législatives 2024, Les Chiffres exacts"), read on 2026-11-13: 130 Pastef, 16 Takku Wallu, 7 Diam Ak Njarin, 3 Samm Sa Kaddu, 2 Andu Nawle and one seat each for seven other lists. The page also shows a parliamentary group PASTEF LES PATRIOTES with 99 members; the chart follows the election result, not the groups. No supporter is a sitting member, so no seat is lit.
